brands.evidence: Monzo’s standard Instant Access Savings Pot currently pays 2.80% AER (variable) on the free plan.

client_claims.text: Monzo’s standard Instant Access Savings Pot currently pays 2.80% AER (variable) on the free plan.
Extra is £3/month, Perks £9/month, and Max from £19/month.
Paid plans raise the Instant Access rate to 3.15%–3.80% AER depending on plan (Extra 3.15%, Plus/Premium/Perks 3.55%, Max 3.80%).
client_claims.note: Facts only cover the free plan rate.

client_claims.text: Select Access Savings: 3.45% AER on free plan, or 3.70% with paid plans; requires £500 minimum deposit and max two withdrawals per year.
Fixed Rate Savings: up to 5.25% AER fixed for a 3-year term.
Interest is calculated daily and paid into the pot on the 1st of each month; free plan up to £1,000,000.
Cash ISAs: Select Access Cash ISA pays up to 3.70% AER; Instant Access Cash ISA pays the same instant-access rates.
